description: This file provides support for Mattermost slash commands, including registration, updating, deletion, parsing callback payloads, and configuration management. It defines types for command configurations, payloads, responses, and includes functions for managing commands via the Mattermost REST API, as well as handling incoming command requests.

methods.name: listMattermostCommands
methods.description: Fetches existing custom slash commands for a team.

methods.name: createMattermostCommand
methods.description: Creates a new custom slash command on a team.

methods.name: registerSlashCommands
methods.description: Registers multiple slash commands, avoiding duplicates and updating existing ones if needed.

methods.name: cleanupSlashCommands
methods.description: Deletes all registered slash commands that are managed by this process.

methods.name: parseSlashCommandPayload
methods.description: Parses incoming slash command payloads from JSON or URL-encoded bodies.

methods.name: resolveCommandText
methods.description: Resolves the trigger to the original command name and constructs the command text.

methods.name: resolveSlashCommandConfig
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the slash command configuration.

methods.name: isSlashCommandsEnabled
methods.description: Determines if slash commands are enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: collectMattermostSlashCallbackPaths
methods.description: Collects callback paths from configuration for routing.

methods.name: resolveCallbackUrl
methods.description: Constructs the callback URL for slash command POST requests.
